user.title: Set up RF Bridge Codes
user.description: Pick your RF Bridge's send action. If the list is empty, add the ESPHome YAML from the README to your bridge first.

error.invalid_service: This must be a domain.service string, e.g. esphome.rf_bridge_send_raw_code

abort.already_configured: This RF Bridge is already set up

learn.title: Learn a new code
learn.description: Give the code a name, press Submit, then press the button on your remote.

review.title: Got it
review.description: Captured a code for "{name}". Send it to check it works before saving. If it doesn't, learn it again: a quick, single press works best.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: How many times each code is sent back to back. If a light toggles twice from one press, lower this. If codes are often missed, raise it.

progress.capture: Press the button on your remote now (waiting up to {timeout} seconds to learn "{name}").

abort.capture_failed: Couldn't learn the code: {error}. Hold the remote close to the bridge and try again. If it keeps failing, check the ESPHome YAML in the README.
